  • Method Details

    • at

      public ScrollContainer.Builder at(int childX, int childY)
      Sets the panel-local origin for this ScrollContainer.

    • size

      public ScrollContainer.Builder size(int width, int height)
      Sets the viewport dimensions (full width includes scrollbar gutter).

    • content

      public ScrollContainer.Builder content(List<PanelElement> content)
      Sets the pre-positioned content list. Children's childX / childY are relative to the viewport's top-left (the scrollable area's content origin). Required.

      Default contentHeight(int) is auto-computed from max(child.childY + child.height) unless explicitly overridden.

    • contentHeight

      public ScrollContainer.Builder contentHeight(int contentHeight)
      Explicit override for the total content height. By default, ScrollContainer auto-computes content height from the children passed to content. Override when you want a different value — typically: trailing padding for comfortable scroll-past-end, capped scroll extent smaller than children would give, or supplier-driven content where auto-compute can't see the real size.

    • scrollOffset

      public ScrollContainer.Builder scrollOffset(DoubleSupplier supplier, @Nullable DoubleConsumer callback)
      Sets the scroll position state via a supplier (read each frame) and an optional callback (fired on scroll events). Required.

      Per Principle 8 (lens not store): consumer holds the state, library reads via the supplier and notifies via the callback. Pass null for the callback if you want a read-only scroll display (no scroll input is consumed).

    • disabledWhen

      public ScrollContainer.Builder disabledWhen(BooleanSupplier disabledWhen)
      Optional disabled predicate (Phase 3b — Item 8). When it returns true, the scrollbar renders with the disabled sprite and all input (wheel, drag, child-click dispatch) is ignored — the viewport becomes a static, inert pane. Per-frame predicate shape, matching the simple widgets' disabledWhen. Default: always enabled.

    • build

      public ScrollContainer build()
      Builds the configured ScrollContainer.

    • spec

      public ElementSpec spec()
      Layout terminal (Phase 3b — Item 6). Returns an ElementSpec for use in Row / Column. The spec's reported dimensions are the configured .size(w, h); the layout helper calls ElementSpec.at(int, int), which re-runs this builder's configuration positioned at the computed coordinates.
